name: commonplace
description: Search Commonplace, a marketplace for large second-hand items with delivery, and, for signed-in sellers, list and manage items.

interface.longDescription: Commonplace is a marketplace for large second-hand items (fitness equipment, furniture, hot tubs, golf carts) with pickup, inspection and delivery handled for you. Search live listings with the delivered price to your ZIP. Signed-in sellers can price, list and manage items; every change is previewed and needs their confirmation. Purchases are completed on trycommonplace.com.
defaultPrompt: Find me a used Peloton Bike+ I can get delivered to 78704 for under $1,300.
What would I take home if I sell my hot tub for $3,000?
How do delivery, inspection and returns work on Commonplace?
